alerts.name: Suspicious Email Attachment Delivered
alerts.description: An email containing a malicious Microsoft Office document (invoice_Q2_report.docm) was delivered to a user's mailbox. The file contains embedded macro code.

raw_data.Email_Subject: Urgent: Q2 Invoice and Payment Discrepancy

alerts.name: Office Application Spawning PowerShell
alerts.description: Microsoft Word (WINWORD.EXE) executed a new process instance of PowerShell, which is highly unusual behavior and indicative of macro-based malware execution.

alerts.name: High-Risk Outbound Connection to Foreign Infrastructure
alerts.description: Suspicious network connection initiated by PowerShell to a known high-risk external IP address used for staged malware delivery.

alerts.name: Suspicious Service Creation and Execution (Persistence)
alerts.description: A newly downloaded binary (svchost_update.exe) installed itself as a system service named 'WinSysUpdater' configured for automatic startup.

alerts.name: Internal Lateral Movement Attempt via SMB/PsExec
alerts.description: The compromised workstation is attempting to use Administrator credentials (via PsExec or similar tool) to connect and execute files on a high-value file server (FILESERVER02).

alerts.name: Attempt to Stop Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS)
alerts.description: System process attempted to stop critical data recovery and backup services, specifically Volume Shadow Copy (VSS), indicating preparation for data encryption.

alerts.name: Mass File Encryption Detected (Ransomware Activity)
alerts.description: High volume of file renaming and creation of ransom notes across multiple network shares, coupled with file extension changes to '.locked'.
